It wasn't straight forward to find a local installer in our region which offered the right competence, service, quality products and value for money. Midwest Solar Power have provided all of this from the first contact and that's why we have chosen them.The goal was to design a solar system optimised for maximum self consumption and taking shading conditions into account as our location is a little special. After several rounds and a few visits we decided to go for an unusual installation where some panels facing north-east (to catch the morning sun) and some panels facing south-west. It generates now energy all day around from early morning until late afternoon which is great. The first weeks have all ready proven it was the right decision.Working with Midwest Solar Power was a pleasure. They have been very friendly, have taken their time and didn't push at all. The installation itself was quick and very professional. They even helped to sort out issues with Western Power and are asking regularly how the system is performing. We are very pleased about our decision. We can only recommend to choose a local installer for your solar project.
